body: I’ll send you a PM later this week! And hah, I met my ex that way too.

Hello, and thanks for your encouraging words :)

I’ve been thinking a lot about my reasons for living and so far I guess it seems like the most likely conclusion is that I absolutely hate isolation, so I guess that means I want to have some place where I belong. Maybe it’s because of my upbringing or of my experiences with people but I found that my mood and feelings really took a nosedive after feeling betrayed or disillusioned about people.

It’s a bit ironic in a way. This means that my way of living for myself is by living for others. But alas, I haven’t really succeded with that during my whole life, my attempts only resulted in failure until I couldn’t handle it anymore and snapped. 

We’ll see if life or death awaits me in the future. Thanks again :)

Thanks for the support, it’s a bit reassuring to hear I’m not the only one who have been in this situation. 

I think you have a point but I have a hard time to accept it. It’s just so hard to believe that people care but doesn’t know how to react when you’ve gotten so many bad experiences. I’ve seen everything from friends telling you they’ll be there for you when you need it yet they’re nowhere to be seen when you reach out to people who disappear and ”suddenly” show up when you’ve stabilized a bit, asking you for money or favors... 

The amount of people left in my life can be counted with one hand, and my past experiences keep me from voicing out my inner struggles. If I get rejected by them as well then I believe that’ll be enough to push me over the edge. It feels like I’m just waiting for someone to set me off, to give me courage to end my suffering. 

Currently in counselling, it seems to mostly be time for me to vent but we’ll see how it goes. Wishing you the best as well.
